Coverage

Compliance Areas

ETA E-Invoicing

Full Egyptian Tax Authority Phase 1 & 2 e-invoicing compliance. RSA-2048 digital signing, UUID tracking, real-time submission.

FRA Anti-Fraud

Aligned with Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority guidelines. Three-way matching gate: PO + ETA UUID + Signed Digital Delivery Note.

Data Protection

GDPR-aligned with encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access controls, and comprehensive audit trails.

ISO/IEC 27001

Information Security Management alignment. Server-side sanitization proxies and stateless data processing architecture.

SOC 2 Type II

Audit-ready posture for enterprise procurement. Independent third-party validation of security, availability, and confidentiality controls.

I-Score Readiness

Clean, real-time risk parameters and repayment velocity metrics fed into corporate credit assessment systems.

Three-Way Matching Gate

Every invoice must pass three independent verification checkpoints before entering the factoring pool. No exceptions. No manual overrides.

Checkpoint 01

Purchase Order

Verified against approved budget blockade. Authority matrix confirmed. Department and property validated.

Checkpoint 02

ETA UUID

Cryptographic invoice signature verified. UUID cross-referenced with ETA portal. Real-time submission confirmed.

Checkpoint 03

Signed Delivery Note

Digital Goods Received Note signed by hotel receiving dock. Quantity and condition confirmed. Timestamp immutable.

Financial Services Disclaimer

HotelsVendors (Returants for E-Marketing, CR: 105300900196948) operates as an e-commerce aggregator and technology platform. We do NOT hold a financial services license.

  • · We do NOT hold client funds or act as a payment intermediary
  • · We do NOT approve, underwrite, or guarantee credit facilities
  • · We do NOT assume credit risk or default liability

All factoring, credit lines, and financial facilities are provided exclusively by licensed third-party grantors (OLIV, ValU, CIB Factoring, Fawry). HotelsVendors facilitates document validation, coordination, and compliance auditing only.
